$comment: The design-style vocabulary used to classify corpus pages. One primary style per page; devices are recorded separately.

styles.C-stack: Stacked or 100% stacked columns or bars
styles.C-small-multiples: Three or more charts in a grid on one scale
styles.C-map: Geographic map, choropleth or flow map
styles.C-combo: Bars with a line on a second axis
styles.C-shared-rows: Several bar columns sharing one set of row labels
styles.C-bubble-grid: Grid of sized bubbles, rows by columns
styles.C-dot-plot: Dot plot or dumbbell per row
styles.C-over-photo: Chart set over a full-bleed photograph
styles.C-radial: Radial bars: concentric arcs, one share per ring
styles.C-pictogram: Icon array, people or unit pictograms
styles.C-sankey: Sankey or bipartite flow between two sets
styles.C-bump: Rank table or bump chart across periods
styles.T-text: Text matrix, rows by columns of prose
styles.T-icon-rows: Table whose rows lead with an icon
styles.T-profile: Dense fact sheet of several small tables
styles.T-photo-rows: Table whose rows lead with a photograph
styles.T-logo-rows: Table whose rows lead with a company logo
styles.D-swimlane: Swimlane grid of lanes by stages
styles.D-hub: Hub and spoke around a centre
styles.D-arrows: Rows carried by large arrow shapes
styles.D-zone-matrix: Matrix of coloured risk zones with plotted items
styles.X-columns: Two to four headed text columns
styles.X-numbered-rows: Numbered or lettered rows of text
styles.X-cards: Grid of text or icon cards
styles.X-before-after: From and to, or two contrasting columns
styles.X-labeled-rows: Label cell on the left, text on the right
styles.X-sidebar: Statement or title in a side panel beside content
styles.X-personas: Persona cards with image and quote
styles.X-worksheet: Blank worksheet or template to fill
styles.K-ring: Numbers in circles or progress rings
styles.K-stat-list: Column of large statistics each with a line of text
styles.K-infographic: Dense infographic of numbers, icons and small charts
styles.P-photo-tiles: Row of photo tiles with captions
styles.P-case-study: Case study panel with photo or logo
